short_description: 10 printable tools for a play-first day: checklists, together tokens, helping jobs, chore chart, family plan and 30-day tracker. Fillable, Letter + A4.
long_description:
Give your day a simple, kind shape: jobs first, then play and time together, then screens at their usual spot. Nothing is taken away; there's just more play to add.

This kit has 10 printable tools, organized by age. The Play First, Then Screens checklist comes as a picture version for ages 2–5, a word version for ages 5–12, and a fillable blank, each in 4 colorways with Monday or Sunday starts. Little ones get a helping-jobs chart and a first-then-later Play-First Board. Big kids get a family jobs chart with a "who" column.

For the whole family, there are 24 together tokens (12 ready-made, 12 make-your-own), six screen-spot cards (5 more minutes, screens go to sleep, what we do next), a family rules poster, a warm three-page Family Play & Screen Plan, a 30-day play tracker with 30 no-buy play ideas, and a certificate to celebrate.

Tokens earn play and time together, never screen minutes, and the screen spot stays the same every day. A two-page grown-up guide covers a 2-minute setup, three easy talk lines and how it works at each age, plus printing, laminating and velcro tips. Every play follows our published safety rules.

You get a color file and a low-ink file in US Letter and A4, with type-in fields that work in free Adobe Acrobat Reader. Instant digital download; no physical item ships.

compliance_notes: Parent education only; no health, medical or developmental-outcome claims, no therapy, autism, ADHD or diagnosis wording anywhere, including keywords and tags (BRAND hard rule 1 and 'Autism searches'). No-guilt test applied: no fear words, 'some days need more screens, and that's okay'. Citations used: WHO 2019 under-5 guidelines and AAP 'Media and Young Minds' 2016 only (BRAND rule 5). Child safety (rule 4): every cut piece is 2.1 in (5.3 cm) or larger (check.js measures the smallest: 2.100 in), straight-line grid cutting, 12 pieces or fewer per page, 'Grown-up keeps the pieces' on every cut sheet, velcro for ages 3+ only with 'check dots before each play; remove any that lift', an actual-size print check on the tips page, a grown-up nearby for every play, water/bubbles/cooking within arm's reach, grown-ups handle knives, heat and glass; no balloons, cords or choking foods. Listing says 'Every play follows our published safety rules' and never 'safety-checked' or 'safe for all ages'. Copyright line and 'Version 1.0 · September 2026' in every page footer; license 'Personal & family use'. Etsy edition (etsy-upload/ and all listing images) carries no URL or QR code (gate #16); own-store edition carries playbeforepixels.com in footers and the bonus QR on the last page and START HERE.
